11.title: Search Summary: write a useful description
11.description: A public lesson page teaches semantic landmarks. Add one meta description in the document head that names the subject and learner benefit without repeating keywords or promising a search ranking.
11.learningObjective: Add a concise, page-specific meta description that accurately summarizes visible page content.
instructions: Keep the document title and visible h1 accurate.
Add one meta element with name="description" in head.
Write a concise sentence that summarizes the page content.
Do not add a second description or claim that metadata guarantees a ranking.

workedExample.input: A public page about semantic HTML landmarks
workedExample.output: One accurate meta description in the head, separate from the visible page heading.
workedExample.explanation: A description can help searchers understand a result, but search engines may generate their own snippet. It should describe the actual page rather than repeat keywords.

11.hint: A search engine may use page text instead of this description, so make the summary useful even when it is not shown as a snippet.
11.explanation: A description can help searchers understand a result, but search engines may generate their own snippet. It should describe the actual page rather than repeat keywords.

testCases.description: Put the description meta element in head.

11.expectedOutput:
Semantic landmarks

Learn to structure a page with meaningful regions.
11.expectedOutputHint: Visual reference only. HTML completion is reviewed against source requirements, not browser-executed tests.
11.starterCode:
Semantic landmarks

Learn to structure a page with meaningful regions.

12.title: Canonical Page: identify the preferred URL
12.description: A public HTML lesson is available through tracking query parameters. Declare the clean public lesson URL as canonical; do not point it at the course home page or a private preview.
12.learningObjective: Declare a page’s preferred absolute URL with a canonical link in the document head.
instructions: Use a link element inside head.
Set rel to canonical.
Use the absolute clean URL without tracking parameters.
Keep the canonical destination equivalent to this lesson page.

workedExample.output: A canonical link to https://learn.example/lessons/semantic-landmarks in head.
workedExample.explanation: Canonical metadata signals the preferred URL when equivalent copies exist. It is a hint to crawlers, not a substitute for correct links or redirects.

12.hint: A canonical URL consolidates duplicate URL variants; it should not be used to redirect unrelated pages.
12.explanation: Canonical metadata signals the preferred URL when equivalent copies exist. It is a hint to crawlers, not a substitute for correct links or redirects.

testCases.description: Use a link element with rel="canonical".
Use the exact absolute clean URL.
Do not canonicalize to a different course or a preview.

12.expectedOutput: Semantic landmarks
12.expectedOutputHint: Visual reference only. HTML completion is reviewed against source requirements, not browser-executed tests.
12.starterCode: Semantic landmarks

instructions: Add one property="og:title" meta element.

14.title: Private Draft: keep a preview out of search results
14.description: A draft lesson preview is publicly reachable only through a temporary review link. Add a robots noindex directive. The page still needs authentication or access controls where privacy matters; metadata alone does not secure it.
14.learningObjective: Mark a private preview page noindex while keeping the indexing directive distinct from access control.
instructions: Add a meta element inside head.
Set name="robots".
Set content="noindex" for the draft preview.
Do not describe this metadata as a password or access restriction.

workedExample.input: A temporary preview of an unpublished lesson
workedExample.output: A robots meta directive containing noindex in head.
workedExample.explanation: Noindex can keep a preview out of search results when crawlers can access it. Confidential material still needs server-side authorization and appropriate deployment controls.

14.hint: Robots directives communicate indexing preferences to cooperative crawlers; they do not block visitors from loading a URL.
14.explanation: Noindex can keep a preview out of search results when crawlers can access it. Confidential material still needs server-side authorization and appropriate deployment controls.

testCases.description: Use a robots meta element in head.
Keep the preview page structure valid.
Do not rely on robots metadata to protect private content.

14.expectedOutput: Landmark lesson preview
14.expectedOutputHint: Visual reference only. HTML completion is reviewed against source requirements, not browser-executed tests.
14.starterCode: Landmark lesson preview
